summary: Report an injury is the one action, with 911 steps, every form by topic, and the Safety Manual. Why: a parent in a hurry finds the right form fast.
blurb: Report an injury in one tap, then every form and handout.

sources.fact: BLSLL Safety Manual (2025): injuries that get first aid or medical treatment are reported to the Safety Officer within 24 to 48 hours on the injury tracking form inside the manual; first aid kits are restocked through the Safety Officer; the 911 steps (field name and location, stay on the line, send someone to the street).
Little League Abuse Awareness Training is required for all volunteers in addition to the background check, valid for the year; use the email you registered with (course link).
Background checks run through JDP, Little League's approved provider; JDP emails the volunteer, who must answer before the check begins.
Volunteers' background checks are emailed automatically by JDP; also complete Abuse Awareness Training with the same email.

long_summary: Safety page with one action: Report an injury in the hero (Email the Safety Officer, plus the injury form in the Safety Manual), a one-line 911 strip, every form and handout by topic, then the Safety Manual PDF and a volunteer clearance link. The lede, clearance steps, first aid kit row, Approved Bats link and the ballpark Safety Code list are off the page, and every PDF links through our portal path.
